title: Grand Prismatic Spring (timelapse) / Grand Prismatic Spring Overlook timelapse
place: Grand Prismatic Spring, Midway Geyser Basin, Yellowstone NP, Wyoming (filmed from the Grand Prismatic Overlook)
notes: Locked-off overlook time-lapse (no camera movement). Whole 14 s: the big turquoise pool with orange/yellow bacterial-mat rings fills the lower-middle of the frame (pool centre x~0.5, y~0.68); steam from Excelsior Geyser crater billows behind it (x~0.35-0.55) and drifts; forested hills on top. Colours get brighter toward the end (best seconds 8-14 in this file, i.e. 30-36 of the original). Pool is wider than the centre square (spans x~0.12-0.85), so the square crop shows the middle of the pool plus rings - still reads well. The boardwalk across the middle (y~0.55) has MANY tiny tourists - dots a few pixels high, not identifiable, but they are visible in the square crop. Parked buses/cars are visible small in the far parking area/road (x~0.05-0.2 and x~0.9, y~0.45). No text or logos. Source 1920x1080 30 fps (Commons 1080p VP9 transcode, because the original file download returned HTTP 429).
fact_en: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone's largest hot spring, is 200-330 feet in diameter and more than 121 feet deep.
